ai_summary: Eriska Investment Fund Ltd has substantially increased its holding in ASHAPURA MINECHEM LTD, acquiring an additional 2.0864% of shares to reach a total stake of 7.2916%. This disclosure, required under SEBI regulations for significant acquisitions, indicates a prominent institutional investor building a larger position, potentially impacting market perception. A notable inconsistency is the document stating "Market Sale" as the mode of acquisition, despite all figures indicating an increase in shares and positive "Buy Quantity" and "Buy Value" detailed in the annexure.
